stories.headline: Freight availability complicates a slower lumber market
stories.body: Madison’s Lumber Reporter’s October 21 market commentary describes transportation constraints during the week ending October 9. Seasonal cargo competed for trucks and railcars, while lumber buyers remained cautious about carrying inventory…

stories.headline: Nominal-volume clarification takes effect for lumber assessments
stories.body: USDA’s final Softwood Lumber Board rule takes effect today, October 22, following publication September 22. It makes nominal volume explicit for assessments, exemptions and reporting. The nominal assessment remains US$0.41 per thousand board…
